findings.title: AI-Generated Content Injunction - Jr. NTR Personality Rights Case
findings.snippet: Delhi HC granted ex-parte ad-interim injunction restraining unauthorized entities from commercially exploiting personality and publicity rights of actor Jr. NTR, including through AI-generated content. Court ordered e-commerce platforms and intermediaries to comply within 72 hours.

findings.title: Enhanced e-KYC and Disclosure for Domain Registrations - Dabur Case
findings.snippet: Delhi HC mandated e-KYC and enhanced disclosure obligations for domain name registrations to curb brand impersonation and online fraud in Dabur India Limited vs. Ashok Kumar & Ors.

findings.title: Age Verification Technologies Workshop
findings.snippet: FTC announced agenda for January 28, 2026 workshop examining age verification technologies. Workshop will be held online only.
